checks.name: typecheck
checks.command: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm --no-deps web npm run typecheck
checks.description: tsc --noEmit inside the web container. No Node required on the host.

checks.name: lint
checks.command: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm --no-deps web npm run lint

checks.name: test
checks.command: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm --no-deps web npm run test
checks.description: Vitest unit and component suite. E2E runs separately via the e2e service.

checks.name: build
checks.command: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm --no-deps web npm run build
